findings.text: commits_between still duplicates the range reader the repository owns at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:504 (reviewed_commits): same git log --reverse --format invocation, same (sha, subject) parse loop, and the repair added first_parent to the copy after the owner had already grown that same flag, so the copy now differs only by its excluding argument. The repair widened the duplicate instead of extending the owner, which is what the earlier review of this run (at eb4735ae3b) named as the remedy; this node's own evidence fragment promotes the duplication as the change.

the record claims 'Both fail at the base revision', but no log files a base-revision run of either case: logs/baseline-suite.log runs only tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, no base-red log for tests/test_a_run_that_merged_primary_lands.py exists in the run directory, and the negative control is a head-revision run under mutation. The earlier review raised the same gap for the first case; the claim has widened to both without an artefact behind it.

the section's done_when second clause, 'A run citing a commit from another branch is still refused', is no longer asserted anywhere: the case now asserts report['would_promote'] is True because the primary branch's citation guard (reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:419-436) accepts a commit reachable from the run's head. The cause is outside this node's write paths and is reported in the manifest's outside_scope, but the reversal means the node's gate cannot report a regression of the clause the section still states, and the section text needs a coordinator decision before the measure reads as met.

the base arm's receipt is misdirected: baseline_suite.log_path names logs/after-suite.log, whose header records revision bb256684ce and a command including tests/test_a_run_that_merged_primary_lands.py, and baseline_suite.command carries that same test file even though it does not exist at the base revision 622ef4617d and the logged command (logs/baseline-suite.log line 5) names only the two other files. A reader resolving the base arm from its own receipt gets the head arm twice; both arms record 0 failures so the derived delta is unaffected, but the receipt cannot be read as the run it claims.
